articles.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
articles.description: A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation. The measured times include real contention. It builds an explicit layer graph and accounts for compute, memory traffic and inter-device communication. It does not mean adding GPUs makes a job slower.
